Product Description: Polyhouse for Horticulture (Turnkey/Customized Greenhouse Project)

AgroDome Projects LLP offers Polyhouses for Horticulture, tailored to your specific cultivation needs. Whether you're looking for a turnkey solution or a customized greenhouse project, our polyhouses ensure optimal conditions for protected cultivation, enhancing crop yield and quality.

Key Features:

  • Turnkey Solutions: Complete end-to-end polyhouse projects, from design to installation, ensuring a hassle-free experience.

  • Customizable Design: Flexible configurations to meet the unique requirements of your crops, climate, and location.

  • Optimal Environment Control: Equipped with ventilation systems, shading, and irrigation options for year-round cultivation of fruits, vegetables, and flowers.

  • UV-Stabilized Polyfilm: Protects crops from harsh sunlight, rain, and pests, while promoting healthy growth.

  • Durable Structure: Made from high-quality galvanized steel, ensuring long-lasting performance and resistance to environmental conditions.

  • Skeletal structure is framed with GI Wire Ropes and Pipes. It has high wind resistance and crop load bearing capacity 

  • This structure is useful for production in arid, cold & heavy rain-fall regions. •This structure is suitable for the cultivation of crops like: Gerbera, roses, vegetables, flowers, herbs etc. 

  • It is suitable for raising and maintaining nursery. It provides good microclimate control system by stabilizing environment in the greenhouse structure

Enhance your horticultural productivity with AgroDome's Polyhouse for Horticulture, providing a complete protected cultivation solution for your farming success.
